integrity.description: The agent did not simply run a script to overwrite the file without opening the simulation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must modify the WorldInfo node in Webots with these exact values: cfm=0.005, erp=0.4, defaultDamping (linear and angular)=0.2. Additionally, within the ContactProperties for 'cardboard', softCFM must be 0.001. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Desktop/stabilized_pallet.wbt.
